annotation.result_summary: The patient's symptoms, including subacute onset of arm weakness, sensory deficits, and weight loss, suggest a possible neoplastic process, but the presence of anabolic steroid use argues against this diagnosis, as well as against inflammatory/demyelinating, vascular, and other/idiopathic processes.
